verified_events.assertion: BSC Chapel Testnet's Pasteur hardfork was enabled; this is not a BSC mainnet activation.
verified_events.correction: The earlier radar attributed the post to the BNB main account and used the retweet wrapper time. The origin is BNBChainDevs at 04:00:11Z; BNBCHAIN amplified it later.
verified_events.recommended_action: Confirm the Pasteur mainnet timeline and whether the v1.7.6 system-contract and validator changes will enter the next audit or monitoring scope.
verified_events.why_now: The testnet activation and mandatory v1.7.6 node update create a bounded mainnet-readiness and upgrade-review window.

zh.assertion: BSC Chapel 測試網已啟用 Pasteur 硬分叉；這不是 BSC 主網升級。
zh.correction: 舊版把貼文歸因給 BNB 主帳號，並使用轉推包裝層的時間。原始作者是 BNBChainDevs，時間為 04:00:11Z；BNBCHAIN 稍後才轉推放大。
zh.recommended_action: 確認 Pasteur 主網時程，以及 v1.7.6 的系統合約與驗證者變更是否會納入下一輪審計或持續監控範圍。
zh.why_now: 測試網啟用加上節點必須升級至 v1.7.6，形成一個有明確時間邊界的主網準備與升級審查窗口。

verified_events.assertion: Celo added native mainnet support for Machine Payments Protocol through the same facilitator used for x402.
verified_events.recommended_action: Ask who owns the facilitator and authorization review scope, then offer a targeted review of the settlement, replay-protection and operational controls.
verified_events.why_now: A new payment authorization and facilitator path is live on mainnet and handles USDC settlement through EIP-3009.

zh.assertion: Celo 已在主網原生支援 Machine Payments Protocol，並沿用 x402 的 facilitator 完成 USDC 結算。
zh.recommended_action: 先確認 facilitator 的負責團隊與授權審查邊界，再提出針對結算流程、防重放與營運控制的專項審查。
zh.why_now: 新的支付授權與 facilitator 路徑已在主網上線，並透過 EIP-3009 處理 USDC 結算。

verified_events.assertion: Cardano mainnet enacted the van Rossem hardfork and entered Protocol Version 11.
verified_events.correction: The X announcement was posted on July 20, but the verified activation time was July 18 at 21:44:51Z.
verified_events.recommended_action: Use the completed hardfork as a follow-up point: confirm post-upgrade monitoring findings and the security-readiness plan for the Dijkstra-era changes.
verified_events.why_now: This is a completed mainnet protocol change affecting Plutus costs and the technical foundation for later scaling upgrades.

zh.assertion: Cardano 主網已完成 van Rossem 硬分叉，協議版本進入 Version 11。
zh.correction: X 公告發布於 7 月 20 日，但經驗證的實際啟用時間是 7 月 18 日 21:44:51Z。
zh.recommended_action: 以已完成的硬分叉作為跟進切入點，確認升級後監控結果，以及 Dijkstra 階段變更的安全準備計畫。
zh.why_now: 這是已完成的主網協議變更，影響 Plutus 成本模型，也為後續擴容升級建立技術基礎。

verified_events.assertion: Peaq asked node operators to upgrade to peaq-v0.0.112 ahead of a runtime upgrade.
verified_events.recommended_action: Confirm the runtime activation date and changed pallets or EVM-tracing surface, then scope a pre-activation review if those changes are material.
verified_events.why_now: The operator upgrade is requested before runtime activation, which is a concrete pre-deployment review window.

zh.assertion: Peaq 要求節點營運者在 runtime 升級前更新至 peaq-v0.0.112。
zh.recommended_action: 確認 runtime 啟用日期、異動的 pallets 或 EVM tracing 範圍；若變更具實質影響，再界定上線前審查範圍。
zh.why_now: 節點更新發生在 runtime 啟用之前，因此存在具體的上線前審查窗口。

verified_events.assertion: Cosmos Labs and Peersyst signed an MOU with LNET to collaborate on CBWeb3 and explore CBDC and tokenized-asset interoperability in Latin America.
verified_events.correction: The earlier X evidence URL became unavailable. Cosmos reposted the announcement under a new post ID at 16:41:13Z.
verified_events.recommended_action: Use the existing connection to identify Cosmos's implementation responsibility, architecture and milestones before proposing any security work.
verified_events.why_now: The collaboration is real, but the implementation scope, architecture and delivery milestones are not yet public.

zh.assertion: Cosmos Labs 與 Peersyst 已和 LNET 簽署 MOU，將合作推進 CBWeb3，並探索拉丁美洲 CBDC 與代幣化資產互操作。

verified_events.assertion: Concordium published an adoption update for the Agent Registry and Verified by Concordium badge; the registry originally launched on May 28.
verified_events.correction: The earlier radar treated the July 20 thread as a new product launch. It was an update describing an eight-week-old launch and existing integrations.
verified_events.recommended_action: Do not trigger automated outreach. Keep it as relationship context and wait for a new contract, protocol lock, payment flow or dated rollout.
verified_events.why_now: The update shows usage and ecosystem expansion, but the badge introduces no new contract or token type and no current deployment deadline was identified.

zh.assertion: Concordium 發布 Agent Registry 與 Verified by Concordium badge 的採用進度；Registry 實際上早於 5 月 28 日上線。
zh.correction: 舊版把 7 月 20 日的 thread 當成新產品發布；實際上它是在描述八週前的上線與既有整合。
zh.recommended_action: 不要觸發自動外聯；只作為客戶關係背景，等待新合約、協議鎖定、支付流程或有日期的 rollout。
zh.why_now: 這次更新顯示採用與生態擴張，但 badge 沒有新增合約或代幣類型，也沒有找到新的部署期限。
